description: IPv6 range create POSTs prefix_length and exactly one assignment target. The two divergences the earlier fixture recorded are closed here: prefix_length is the 56-or-64 pair the API documents (Go accepted 1 through 128), and route_target has to parse as a zoneless IPv6 address (Python accepted any non-empty string). Every sentence is a contract rule, so both languages answer them in the same order.

cases.name: creates a range routed to a linode
creates a range routed to a route target
rejects a prefix_length outside the documented pair
rejects a non-positive linode_id
cases.expect_error: linode_id must be a positive integer

cases.name: rejects a blank route_target
cases.expect_error: route_target must be a non-empty string

cases.name: rejects a route_target that is not an IPv6 address
cases.expect_error: route_target must be a valid IPv6 address

cases.name: rejects a zoned route_target
cases.expect_error: route_target must be a valid IPv6 address

cases.name: refuses both assignment targets
cases.expect_error: linode_id and route_target are mutually exclusive

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This creates an IPv6 range and changes networking configuration. Set confirm=true to proceed.

side_effects: A new IPv6 range with prefix length /64 will be allocated and routed to instance 123.
